proposal.explanation: The primary failure is m_axis_tlast stuck at 0, observed at cycles 6, 7, 19, etc. The root cause is m_axis_tlast_int being hardcoded to 0 (line 141), so frame boundaries never enter the pipeline. Patch_bdfb4e29768c directly fixes this by assigning s_axis_tlast. Secondary issues involve premature pause activation stalling frame completion: patch_05abffd461ff guards the accumulator check with !s_axis_tready, patch_330141055bc5 disables pause logic in frame-rate mode, and patches_390a7a67ed09/177e84f089b9 add alternative pause gating. Patch_4c92a56408a4 stabilizes reset handshake. Patches_73d0959c8d78 and _f89a1677f767 ensure frame-boundary state propagates through the two-stage output registers once generated.

ranking.mechanism: Corrects m_axis_tlast_int to forward the input s_axis_tlast value instead of hardcoding 0, enabling proper frame boundary propagation through the pipeline.
Prevents premature accumulator threshold checks when s_axis_tready is asserted, avoiding incorrect pause activation that stalls frame completion.
Restricts the pause condition to non-frame-rate mode, preventing spurious frame gating when rate_by_frame is active.
Guards s_axis_tready output with rst to avoid premature readiness during reset, indirectly stabilizing frame state initialization.
Uses m_axis_tready backpressure to modulate pause, coupling frame pacing to downstream readiness.
Leverages s_axis_tvalid to gate pause, tying frame continuation to active input data presence.
Seeds m_axis_tlast_reg from the temp register, ensuring frame-boundary state can propagate through the two-deep output pipeline.
Drives store_axis_temp_to_output using m_axis_tlast, linking frame-boundary assertion to pipeline flush.
